cohort: 56 pregnancies in patients with mesenchymal dysplasias, including 23 with Marfan syndrome, 22 with Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, and 11 with Osler-Weber-Rendu syndrome, aged 18 to 36
finding: Pregnant women with mesenchymal dysplasias are at high risk of life-threatening complications during pregnancy and delivery, particularly hemorrhage and cardiovascular complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section is the preferred delivery method for patients with mesenchymal dysplasias due to the high risk of deep vaginal ruptures and serious hemorrhage associated with vaginal delivery.
